description:
`POST /api/v1/agent/artifacts`: "I have this file; may I upload it?"

Idempotent on `(agent_run_id, class, sha256)`: asking again returns the same artifact.

agent_run_id.description: The agent run that produced the file. It must belong to the caller's project.

class.description:
The class, one of [`ArtifactClass::as_str`]. A string, so an older server answers an
unknown class with [`RejectReason::ClassNotAllowed`] instead of failing to parse.

content_type.description:
The declared `Content-Type`; see [`ArtifactClass::content_types`]. The server serves what
the bytes are, not what is declared.

direct.description:
Whether the agent can send the bytes straight to the object store (see the module docs).
Absent from agents that predate direct upload, which then get [`UploadGrant::Upload`].

flow_execution_id.description: The flow execution it is evidence for, if any. It must belong to the same run.

path.description:
The path relative to the run's output directory, redacted. A label for people; it never
names where the server stores the bytes.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the content: 64 lowercase hex digits.

step.description:
The 0-based index of the flow step that produced the file, when Maestro's `artifacts[]`
names it (the step tree's index). The server keeps it on the artifact; absent when no step
produced the file, and from agents that predate it.

title: UploadRequest
